title: Introducing CARaL: Copyright Anxiety, Resilience and Leadership
content:
Many of you will know that Chris and I have been working for some time on research into Copyright Anxiety and Legal Chill. Therefore we are really excited to launch a new collaboration this autumn with the author, coach and trainer, Helen Rimmer. Helen is the author of the Facet book The Kind Librarian and her work on leadership and compassion really struck a chord with our findings that were emerging from the copyright anxiety research.

What’s CARaL all about?

CARaL: Copyright Anxiety, Resilience and Leadership is a new four-part online programme exploring something that traditional copyright training rarely addresses: the emotional, cultural and leadership impact of copyright work.

Copyright is a technical subject, but it is also felt emotionally. The fear of getting something wrong can lead to anxiety, over-checking, unnecessary escalation and what we’re calling “Legal Chill” – where over-caution begins to become a barrier to access, innovation and creativity.
